d:
With the unwavering support of her ex-mother-in-law (Daadi), Suman kickstarts her entrepreneurial journey by selling homemade achaar bottles to passengers on public buses. Despite initial hurdles, she perseveres and manages to sell her entire stock. But just when things seem to be looking up, the police catch her selling without permission and seize all her goods and earnings, leaving her business plans in jeopardy. Will Suman find a way to overcome this setback and get her pickle business back on track?
Watch Ep2 to find out!
Stay tune for Episode 3!
Credits:
Directed by: Apoorv Singh Karki
